verdict.rationale: Cold-start latency is a fair axis for an inference engine like vLLM, but nothing in the evidence documents a lightweight runtime binary or fast startup. The pack shows only a Python package installed via uv/pip, a Docker image and source builds. The cited throughput, batching and TTFT features describe serving performance, not startup time, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get a fast cold start from a lightweight runtime binary instead of waiting seconds before inference begins
